name: Remembrance
description: Discover or directly invoke authorized Remembrance skills in OpenClaw, then close the outcome and feedback loop.

privateLearningEgressApprovals.description: Saved allow-always decisions, one per Remembrance egress lane. The plugin sets a lane to true when the user chooses allow-always; that decision covers only the actions of that lane, such as the private_lesson submit and retry actions.

admin_review_repair.description: Explicit allow-always for repair_review_draft only. Requires organization admin:review authority; creates a complete protected replacement while retaining the original for a separate normal decision. Other private-learning approvals do not cover this lane.

privateLearningSubmitApprovals.description: Legacy per-action approvals. A true value approves the lane of that action.
